known_facts_book1: A terrible beast with a horrible appetite, known to Files only from a blurred picture in an under-ripe story-book from his orchard.
Can fly in the air, run like a deer and swim like a fish, is bigger than a hundred men, and feeds on any living thing.
Carries a glowing furnace of fire inside its body, breathes in air and breathes out smoke that darkens the sky for miles.
Is identified by its breath, which smells of salt and pepper — a fog has no smell at all.
Is shot by Files in the dark, aiming at its two glowing red eyes; one bullet breaks its jaw, one its left wing, one its right leg.
Bears a charmed life and cannot die; its jaw will heal in an hour, its wing in a day and its leg in a week.
Politely lets Files go once it learns he has an engagement with Queen Ann, having first asked him to stay and be eaten.

known_relations_book1.Files: The Private Soldier who shoots and wounds it.
known_relations_book1.the officers of Oogaboo: Whom it falls upon and tries to crush, and who flee from it.

known_facts_book1: The Official Sorceress of the Land of Oz, whose magnificent castle stands far north of the Emerald City.
Owns a magic Record Book in which every event that takes place anywhere is printed the moment it happens, from a child stamping its foot to a city burning down.
Reads the Record Book every day, and so learns of Queen Ann's plan to invade Oz.
Goes into the Magic Room of her castle and performs a ceremony that makes the Oogaboo pass turn and twist, so the Army comes out in an adjoining country instead of in Oz.
Deliberately says nothing about it to Ozma or anyone else, judging it a shame to have the peace of Oz disturbed by quarreling.
Transported Tik-Tok to the crossroads in the wink of an eye at Ozma's request, and taught the Wizard the incantation he uses at the end.
It was in her Record Book that Shaggy Man read of his lost brother's captivity.
Never appears on the page in this book.

known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler whose peace she guards without troubling her about it.
known_relations_book1.Ann Soforth: The Queen whose invasion she diverts without either of them meeting.

known_facts_book1: The Magician named on the silver plate inside the Tube as having burrowed and built it in the Year of the World 19625478 for his own exclusive uses.
Was a great traveler who thought the Tube would save him the bother of going around the earth's surface.
Fell through so fast that he shot out at the other end and hit a star in the sky, which at once exploded; no one knows what became of him.
Was properly punished for his folly in making the Tube, according to Tititi-Hoochoo.
Never appears in this book: he is known only from the engraved plate and from Polychrome's account.
